description: The watching, not the playing. The specific good here is physical rather than cognitive: a body that is working, tired in the correct way, and not being thought about.
The hour after is reliably better than the hour during, and it is the part people actually return for.
The solitary version does a different job: it is one of the few socially acceptable ways to be unreachable for an hour.
energy_note: An hour nobody can call you in.

description: A place, kit, subscription or other people free at the same time. Safety after dark decides a great deal of this, and decides it differently for women.
notes: Where movement after dark is unsafe, this whole family narrows sharply by gender. See BOD/SEC in assets/text/nigeria.

description: Playing football on a screen with people in the room stops being an event and becomes a reference point - retold, compared against, and eventually shorthand inside one family for a whole kind of day.
energy_note: It turns into the story about it.
notes: Experiential purchases retain value through memory where material ones decay; people are markedly unwilling to trade the memory away.
